answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 44812 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Umrah Question: After Umrah is it mandatory to shorten each and every hair of scalp? Does it need to be cut in equal length? Answer ID: 44812 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 713/713/M=1434) If the hair of head is less than one finger tip then it is not correct to do qasr (shorten) rather it is necessary to do halaq and halaq shall be done of complete head. And if there are long hair and they are more than one finger tip then qasr is right in this case and it is not necessary to shorten each and every hair of the head, rather qasr of one fourth hair is also enough. ثم يحلق أو يقصر و الحلق أفضل ويكفى فيه ربع الرأس (مراقى الفلاح) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
